_what_this_is: The document beside this one with the three near misses repaired and nothing else changed. It has to pass. It also breaks the advisory rule on purpose, because a second commit names an issue the pull request does not, so a run over it prints a warning and still exits zero. That is what proves the two tiers are separate rather than one tier with two words for it.
title: Add the deterministic check over the pull request itself (#100)
